_comment: R402: each shape's expected outcome under the builds [], [LETHALX], [LETHALY], [LETHALX,LETHALY]. 'refused' names the preproc-undecided reason prefix; an admitted shape lists its generateMutationSet spec count per build, measured on master 0ef6652f, where every admitted shape had the same counts. R196 (identity scheme 10) re-measured the loop shapes: each variable a loop condition reads loses its remove-assignment and swap-additive sites (2 per variable); t1/t2 (a boolean #if tail of a while condition, and of an if outside a loop) were added for R239; w1/w2 (whole members inside a `#if` right after the global var section, which the grammar swallows into that section) were added for R-327b, measured on master 047857ef; w3 (typing inside a swallowed member) and w4..w6 were added for R-327b / R720 and measured after the R720 fix (w4: a swallowed member's loop writes are refused by name, 20 -> 16 specs; w5: a global declared in a var-section #if, 7 -> 6; w6: a swallowed table Validate overload, 29/15 both before and after; R731 69478059 made w6 28 because a bare field of the implicit record typed as unknown and was refused, and R752 restores 29); w7 is R480's for-control write (`for P := 10 downto 1 do if Found then P := 1`) in the R720 shapes (a swallowed member local, a var-section #if global, an every-arm-ambiguous local) beside a direct twin: BEFORE the for-aware by-name match 18/13/18/13 specs, AFTER 12/9/12/9. scripts/r402-shape-sweep.ts exits 1 on any difference. R796 (tree-sitter-al 4.5.0, measured with the unit half only, NOT the alc compile half): w1, w2, w6 are direct members now (15 -> 16, 7 -> 8, 29 -> 32 in the builds that compile the member); and ten shapes that 4.4.1 refused (c7b, c7e, c7f, c8 and s4..s4d: directive-continues-statement; s8, s12: marker-mismatch) now parse with the `#if` attached to the loop (c7b, c7e, c7f, c8 and s4..s4d as a preproc_conditional_expression_tail; s8 as a preproc_operand_prefix; s12 as a nested tail) and are ADMITTED with the counts above. u1..u6 (R796 review) are new 4.5.0 shapes: a preproc_conditional_operand (u1), a condition that starts with `#if` (u2), preproc_conditional_arguments (u3), a prefix inside a binary (u4), the R295 conditional-names declaration (u5) and the preproc_split_var_section_tail selector shape (u6); counts measured by the unit half only. s8's prefix operand is hang-refused by the loop-hazard fix in the same change (without it s8 would be 10/11/10/11 and `or` in place of `and` would hang). Admitting them is unproven until the sweep's alc half and a hang review run on them: see the roadmap item named in R796.
